ayahs.text: وَٱلطُّورِ

tr.sahih: By the mount
tr.pickthall: By the Mount,

ayahs.text: وَكِتَـٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ

tr.sahih: And [by] a Book inscribed
tr.pickthall: And a Scripture inscribed

ayahs.text: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ

tr.sahih: In parchment spread open
tr.pickthall: On fine parchment unrolled,

ayahs.text: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ

tr.sahih: And [by] the frequented House
tr.pickthall: And the House frequented,

ayahs.text: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ

tr.sahih: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high
tr.pickthall: And the roof exalted,

ayahs.text: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ

tr.sahih: And [by] the sea set on fire,
tr.pickthall: And the sea kept filled,

ayahs.text: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
tr.pickthall: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;

ayahs.text: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ

tr.sahih: Of it there is no preventer.
tr.pickthall: There is none that can ward it off.

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا

tr.sahih: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
tr.pickthall: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,

ayahs.text: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا

tr.sahih: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
tr.pickthall: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,

ayahs.text: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

tr.sahih: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
tr.pickthall: Then woe that day unto the deniers

ayahs.text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ

tr.sahih: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
tr.pickthall: Who play in talk of grave matters;

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

tr.sahih: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
tr.pickthall: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell

ayahs.text: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

tr.sahih: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
tr.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.

ayahs.text: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
tr.pickthall: Is this magic, or do ye not see?

ayahs.text: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
tr.pickthall: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,

ayahs.text: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.

ayahs.text: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
tr.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,

ayahs.text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

tr.sahih: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
tr.pickthall: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.

ayahs.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ

tr.sahih: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
tr.pickthall: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.

ayahs.text: وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

tr.sahih: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
tr.pickthall: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.

ayahs.text: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ

words.gloss: They will pass to one another

tr.sahih: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
tr.pickthall: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.

ayahs.text: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ

tr.sahih: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
tr.pickthall: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.

ayahs.text: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
tr.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,

ayahs.text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ

tr.sahih: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].
tr.pickthall: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;

ayahs.text: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ

tr.sahih: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
tr.pickthall: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.

ayahs.text: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
tr.pickthall: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.

ayahs.text: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ

tr.sahih: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
tr.pickthall: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.

ayahs.text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ

tr.sahih: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?
tr.pickthall: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?

ayahs.text: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ

tr.sahih: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
tr.pickthall: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.

ayahs.text: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
tr.pickthall: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?

ayahs.text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
tr.pickthall: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!

ayahs.text: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
tr.pickthall: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.

ayahs.text: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ

tr.sahih: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
tr.pickthall: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?

ayahs.text: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

tr.sahih: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
tr.pickthall: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!

ayahs.text: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ

tr.sahih: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
tr.pickthall: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?

ayahs.text: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

tr.sahih: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].
tr.pickthall: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!

ayahs.text: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ

tr.sahih: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
tr.pickthall: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?

ayahs.text: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
tr.pickthall: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?

ayahs.text: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

tr.sahih: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
tr.pickthall: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?

ayahs.text: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
tr.pickthall: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!

ayahs.text: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

tr.sahih: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
tr.pickthall: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!

ayahs.text: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ

tr.sahih: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
tr.pickthall: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.

ayahs.text: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ

tr.sahih: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
tr.pickthall: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

tr.sahih: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
tr.pickthall: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
tr.pickthall: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.

ayahs.text: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

tr.sahih: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise
tr.pickthall: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,

ayahs.text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ

tr.sahih: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
tr.pickthall: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.
